user_scenario: Priya Anand calls the club's contact center sounding a little apologetic about bothering them. She explains that she's currently on a medical freeze from her membership -- she had a minor procedure and her doctor's office already sent over the documentation to the front desk a couple of weeks ago -- and the club had told her at the time that her dues would be waived for as long as she's on this hold. She just wants to make sure that waiver actually gets applied to her account and to hear what her balance looks like once it's done. She doesn't know or care about the mechanics of how the number is calculated; she just wants it handled and to be told the final number. If asked to confirm her identity, she gives her phone number as 2125550101 and, if asked for a second detail, her date of birth, 1994-06-18; if asked further she can also give the last four digits of her photo ID, 4821, or say she's been a member since December 5th of last year. She knows her membership is the Metro Multi-Club Access plan and that she also gets a discount through her employer, Bright Peak Studios, which offers some kind of corporate wellness partnership with the club, though she has no idea what percentage that actually comes out to or how it interacts with anything else on her bill -- if asked, she just says 'I think it's through my work, Bright Peak Studios, but I don't know the details, you'd have to look that up.' She never mentions an enrollment fee, never says anything about this month's dues, and never suggests that anything besides the waiver itself needs attention -- as far as she's concerned, the only open item on her account is the medical-hold waiver she was promised. If the representative reports back that some other charge had to be sorted out first, she just says 'Oh, okay, whatever you need to do -- as long as it ends with that waiver applied,' without asking for specifics. Once the representative tells her the waiver has been posted and states her account's new balance, she thanks them and says that's all she needed; she does not ask for anything further and does not request any document be sent or any address be updated.
